                        # Conversation Summary: codx-junior-ui Mobile Layout Design

## Context
Design document (AS IS → TO BE) for adding mobile support to **codx-junior-ui**, a Vue.js desktop docking panel application.

---

## AS IS: Desktop Architecture

- **Root component:** `Desktop.vue` using `dockview-vue` library
- **19 registered dockable panels** (chat, tasks, files, wiki, kanban, knowledge, settings, etc.)
- **Panel lifecycle:** `$ui.showTab(name)` → `addAppPanel()` → `dockviewApi.addPanel()`
- **Persistence:** `dockviewApi.toJSON()` → `localStorage['dockview-layout']`
- **Rendering:** `renderer: 'always'` — all panels stay mounted in DOM simultaneously
- **Tab system:** Custom `Tab.vue` component per panel
- **Store integrations:** `$ui` (open apps, tab management) + `$chats` (chat rehydration on restore)
- **Auto-save triggers:** `onDidAddPanel`, `onDidRemovePanel`, `onDidLayoutChange`

### Key Limitations
- No mobile layout exists
- `renderer: 'always'` causes high memory usage with 19 panels
- `$ui` and `$chats` store contracts undocumented
- No deep linking / URL navigation
- No responsive breakpoints

---

## TO BE: Mobile Layout Design

### Core Principle
> Same stores + same panel components, different shell. `Desktop.vue` untouched.

### Device Routing (`App.vue`)
```
isMobile (window.innerWidth < 768) → <MobileLayout />
else → <Desktop />
```

### Shell Structure (`MobileLayout.vue`)
- **TopAppBar** — title + hamburger + notifications + avatar
- **Main area** — `<keep-alive :include="recentViews" :max="3">` wrapping active component
- **BottomNavBar** — 4 tabs: Tasks | Chat | Files | More
- **MoreDrawer** — bottom sheet grid with all 14 remaining panels

### Panel Priority Tiers
| Tier | Panels | Cache Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Primary | `tasks`, `chat`, `files` | Always cached, eagerly loaded |
| Secondary | `activity`, `projects`, `wiki`, `docs`, `profiles` | `defineAsyncComponent`, cached up to max=3 |
| Tertiary | `metrics`, `log-viewer`, `knowledge`, `knowledge_settings`, `settings`, `global-settings`, `account`, `file-finder`, `home` | Lazy loaded, not cached |

### Memory Strategy
- Replaces `renderer: 'always'` with `<keep-alive :max="3">`
- FIFO eviction of non-primary panels from cache
- `defineAsyncComponent` for secondary + tertiary panels

### State Persistence (`useMobileLayout.js`)
- Storage key: `mobile-layout`
- Saves: `{ activeView, recentViews }` to `localStorage`
- Restores on `onMounted`

### New Files
```
client/src/components/mobile/
  MobileLayout.vue
  BottomNavBar.vue
  TopAppBar.vue
  MoreDrawer.vue
client/src/composables/
  useDevice.js
  useMobileLayout.js
```
**Modified:** `App.vue` only  
**Untouched:** `Desktop.vue`, all 19 panel components

### Mobile UX Details
- Default view: `KanbanContainer` (tasks)
- `height: 100dvh` for dynamic viewport
- `env(safe-area-inset-*)` for notch/home bar support
- `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` for iOS momentum scroll
- MoreDrawer renders as 3-column icon grid bottom sheet

### Deferred Items
- Deep linking (Vue Router integration needed)
- External wiki iframe/link strategy
- Auth/session management
- Full `$ui` / `$chats` store contracts for mobile chat hydration

---

## Keywords
`vue3`, `composition-api`, `dockview-vue`, `mobile-layout`, `responsive`, `keep-alive`, `defineAsyncComponent`, `bottom-navigation`, `bottom-sheet`, `safe-area-inset`, `100dvh`, `localStorage`, `panel-management`, `lazy-loading`, `memory-optimization`, `MobileLayout.vue`, `BottomNavBar.vue`, `TopAppBar.vue`, `MoreDrawer.vue`, `useDevice.js`, `useMobileLayout.js`, `$ui-store`, `$chats-store`, `desktop-first`, `codx-junior-ui`, `panel-tiers`, `FIFO-cache`, `dockview-layout`, `KanbanContainer`, `ChatView`, `dockview-theme-abyss`

# Task Description: Apply Mobile UX CSS Details to Mobile Components

## Objective
Enhance the mobile layout of **codx-junior-ui** by applying precise CSS details to the four mobile components. All styles must be scoped, use modern mobile CSS APIs, and deliver a smooth, notch-safe, animation-rich experience.

---

## Files to Modify

```
client/src/components/mobile/MobileLayout.vue
client/src/components/mobile/TopAppBar.vue
client/src/components/mobile/BottomNavBar.vue
client/src/components/mobile/MoreDrawer.vue
```

---

## Per-Component Requirements

### 1. `MobileLayout.vue`

**Root Container:**
- Height must be `100dvh` (dynamic viewport height) — NOT `100vh`
- This ensures the layout adapts when the browser address bar appears/disappears on mobile
- Prevent horizontal overflow: add `overflow-x: hidden` to root container
- Structure: vertical flex column (`flex flex-col`) to stack TopAppBar → main → BottomNavBar

```
Root div:
  height: 100dvh
  overflow-x: hidden
  display: flex
  flex-direction: column

Main content area:
  flex: 1
  overflow-y: auto
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch   ← iOS momentum scrolling
  overflow-x: hidden
```

---

### 2. `TopAppBar.vue`

**Safe Area Inset for Notched Devices:**
- The top bar must account for the status bar / notch on iPhone X+ and modern Android devices
- Use CSS `env()` function for dynamic padding

```
Top bar container:
  padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top)
  position: fixed (or sticky)
  top: 0
  width: 100%
  overflow: hidden  ← prevent horizontal bleed
```

---

### 3. `BottomNavBar.vue`

**Safe Area Inset for Home Indicator:**
- The bottom nav must pad above the home indicator bar on iPhone X+ and gesture-nav Android devices

```
Bottom nav container:
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)
  position: fixed
  bottom: 0
  width: 100%
  overflow: hidden  ← prevent horizontal bleed
```

---

### 4. `MoreDrawer.vue`

This is the most complex component. Requirements:

#### A. Backdrop Overlay
- A semi-transparent dark overlay (`rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`) covering the full screen behind the drawer
- Must be rendered conditionally when drawer is open
- Clicking the backdrop closes the drawer
- Use `fixed inset-0` positioning with a z-index below the drawer

```
Backdrop:
  position: fixed
  inset: 0 (top/right/bottom/left: 0)
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
  z-index: 40
  visible only when drawer isOpen === true
```

#### B. Drawer Sheet
- Slides up from the bottom of the screen when open
- Slides back down when closed
- Use CSS `transition` on `transform: translateY`

```
Drawer container:
  position: fixed
  bottom: 0
  left: 0
  right: 0
  z-index: 50
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)   ← notch support
  overflow: hidden
  
  transition: transform 0.3s ease
  
  When closed:  transform: translateY(100%)
  When open:    transform: translateY(0)
```

#### C. Grid Layout
- The icon grid inside the drawer must be a **3-column CSS grid**
- Each cell: icon + label, centered

```
Grid container:
  display: grid
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)
  gap: 16px
  padding: 16px
```

#### D. Open/Close State
- Controlled by a reactive boolean `isOpen`
- Drawer visibility driven by CSS transform (not `v-if`) so transition plays correctly
- Backdrop uses `v-show` or `v-if` tied to `isOpen`

---

## Component Structure (All Files)

Follow the established Vue component pattern:

```vue
<script setup>
// imports only
</script>

<template>
  <!-- template markup with Tailwind classes -->
</template>

<script>
export default {
  data() { return { isOpen: false } },
  computed: {},
  methods: {}
}
</script>
```

**Styling rules:**
- Use TailwindCSS utility classes wherever possible
- For properties not available in Tailwind (`env()`, `100dvh`, `-webkit-overflow-scrolling`, `transform: translateY`), use scoped `<style scoped>` blocks
- All `<style>` blocks must have the `scoped` attribute

---

## Summary Checklist

| Requirement | Component | CSS Property |
|---|---|---|
| `height: 100dvh` | MobileLayout | `height: 100dvh` |
| No horizontal overflow | All | `overflow-x: hidden` |
| iOS momentum scroll | MobileLayout (main) | `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` |
| Top safe area | TopAppBar | `padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top)` |
| Bottom safe area | BottomNavBar | `padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` |
| Bottom safe area | MoreDrawer | `padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` |
| 3-column grid | MoreDrawer | `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` |
| Slide-up animation | MoreDrawer | `transform: translateY(0/100%)` + `transition` |
| Backdrop overlay | MoreDrawer | `position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` |
| Scoped styles | All | `<style scoped>` |

---

## Expected Output

Four fully implemented Vue components (`MobileLayout.vue`, `TopAppBar.vue`, `BottomNavBar.vue`, `MoreDrawer.vue`) with all mobile UX CSS requirements applied, scoped styles, correct component structure (`script setup` → `template` → `script`), and no horizontal overflow.
